topic: ML traffic prediction job variable check
summary_markdown: Someone shared a link to an AllUnite jobs repository related to ML traffic prediction. [me] reviewed the setup and noted that the `USE_DEVICE_AGG_DEV` variable was not explicitly set, but since its default value is 1, they requested recalculation using this assumption and review of the results.
action_items: Run the ML traffic prediction job with USE_DEVICE_AGG_DEV set to 1 and analyze the resulting data.
